request.voice_description: A huge demonic warlord shouting on a battlefield. Deep, booming male voice in the low baritone-bass range, around 110 to 150 Hz, powerful and resonant rather than raspy, no vocal fry. Dark, warm, slightly muffled timbre as if echoing in a cavern, with a short hall reverb. Forceful, proud and contemptuous, each short phrase punched out at a brisk pace. Theatrical fantasy villain. Clean recording, no music.
request.text: Tremble before me! In Mannoroth's name! To the slaughter! I go to destroy! This will please me. Pitiful! You fail to amuse me. I bring darkness! What trickery is this?
